title: Individuals using the Internet in Australia (% of population)
attribution: International Telecommunication Union (ITU), World Telecommunication/ICT Indicators Database, via World Bank World Development Indicators.
observation: Individuals who used the Internet in the preceding three months; an annual measure of current use, not cumulative first adoption.
transformation: Validate indicator/country, sort calendar years ascending, set time=year-1990, copy numeric values unchanged, keep missing observations as empty CSV fields; exclude missing rows only at fitting, without compressing elapsed time.
limitations: A descriptive saturation-curve example; aggregate current use does not identify a causal adoption mechanism.
Survey definitions, source revisions and country reporting can change values. The frozen extract is not automatically updated.
Missing years are not zero use. No interpolation, stock summation, forward filling or random train/test split is used.
Point fits do not supply calibrated uncertainty; calendar holdout metrics are an example-specific diagnostic.
The retrospective calendar holdout uses the November 2026 data vintage; revisions mean it is not an as-of-2015 real-time backtest. Repeated cutoff selection after inspecting scores is exploratory.
